name: Monster Girl Clinic
source:
Eight women. One waiting room. You.

The catch: you're the only human patient at the Monster Girl Clinic, a court sent you here because reorganising a man's entire life without asking him for six months turned out to be a condition rather than a hobby — and your treatment plan is one line long: stop fixing people.

[From [url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/monster-girl-clinic]itch[/url]]
translation:
八位女性，一间候诊室，外加一个你。

问题在于：你是“魔物娘诊所”里唯一的人类病患——只因你在未经他人同意的情况下擅自把一个男人的全部生活重新安排了整整半年，法院认定这属于心理病症而非个人爱好，一纸判决把你送进了这里；而你的治疗方案从头到尾只有一句话：别再想着改造别人了。

[摘自[url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/monster-girl-clinic]itch[/url]]
